when.quote: Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides bonus APY on your Gold Account balance.

starts.note: customer: start only when the customer asks which savings account and credit card (and, if they ask, which new checking account) to open together to earn the most. The agent recommends one combination. The customer applies for the card with their own apply_for_credit_card tool. The savings account is opened only if the customer asks, in opening_personal_savings_accounts. Never open a checking account the customer did not ask for. If the customer asks for a new checking account too, include it in the recommendation and open it only in opening_personal_checking_accounts.
starts.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

tools.not_used: This job only recommends. Opening the savings account is the job opening_personal_savings_accounts (see handoff_open_savings); opening a new checking account is opening_personal_checking_accounts (see handoff_open_checking).
Funding the new savings account belongs to opening_personal_savings_accounts, and only if the customer authorizes it.
Closing an old checking account belongs to closing_personal_checking_accounts (see handoff_close_checking).
apply_for_credit_card is one of the customer's standard tools, not a discoverable one, so there is nothing to give.
The documents cover every step. Transfer only under the general policy: ask first, or after the customer has asked 4 times.

steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Retrieve the customer's existing credit cards, since only the highest card APY bonus applies

steps.do: Ask for any missing facts before deciding: deposit amount, holding pattern, paper-statement need, credit score, card preferences, Rho-Bank+ subscription and monthly card spending
steps.if: any of these facts has not been stated
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: Also ask, unless already stated: whether the customer is open to a credit card at all, any feature the card must have (e.g. travel insurance), whether they want a new checking account and any feature it must have (e.g. early direct deposit), and the highest ongoing savings minimum balance they can keep. Ask before deciding.
steps.if: any of these requirements has not been stated
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: If the customer's current checking account is not in a listed boost pairing, ask whether they would open a different checking account. If they refuse, count no boost that needs a new checking account, and never open one.
steps.if: open_to_new_checking has not been stated
steps.quote: Only these specific pairings qualify for the linked checking account APY boost.

steps.do: Drop savings accounts whose opening deposit is above the customer's deposit, and drop accounts that require paperless statements if the customer needs paper
steps.quote: Paperless statements are required for this account: Yes.

steps.do: Drop savings accounts whose ongoing minimum balance is above the highest minimum the customer said they can keep: Gold $10,000, Gold Plus $25,000, Platinum $50,000, Platinum Plus $100,000, Diamond Elite $250,000. An account kept exactly at its minimum stays in.
steps.if: the customer stated a highest acceptable minimum balance
steps.quote: Maintain at least $50,000 to preserve Platinum benefits.

steps.do: List the personal checking classes the customer could open that have every required feature. For early direct deposit keep only classes with more than 0 days: Blue (1 day), Green Account (checking) (up to 1 day), Dark Green (1 day), Evergreen (up to 2), Purple (2), Bluest (2), Gold Years (up to 2); drop Light Blue, Light Green and Green Fee-Free (0 days). Drop classes the customer's DOB (v_lookup) fails as of v_time: Gold Years 62+, Dark Green 17–26, Light Green 13–24. Drop Bluest if the customer cannot deposit $75,000. Leave out the class the customer is replacing.
steps.if: the customer wants or accepts a new checking account
steps.quote: Get direct deposits up to 1 day early

steps.do: Drop cards whose minimum score is above the customer's score, cards that are invitation-only, cards that need Rho-Bank+ when the customer has none, and cards the customer refuses (for example, EcoCard has no credit-score requirement)
steps.quote: Minimum credit score required to apply: 0 (0 indicates no credit score requirement).

steps.do: Keep only cards with every feature the customer requires. For travel insurance, the only personal card whose documents include it is the Silver Rewards Card (up to $15,000 per trip, $0.00 annual fee, minimum score 680).
steps.if: the customer is open to a card and stated a required card feature
steps.quote: Per-trip coverage limit: up to $15,000

steps.do: If the customer does not know or will not give a credit score, do not drop a card for that reason; tell them the card's minimum score (Silver Rewards 680) and that approval is decided by the application.
steps.if: the customer has not given a credit score
steps.quote: Minimum credit score: $680

steps.do: If no savings account or no card survives the filters, tell the customer which requirement rules each option out (opening deposit, paperless requirement, credit score, subscription, invitation, a card type they refuse). Do not invent exceptions, and stop.
steps.if: filter_savings or filter_cards leaves no candidate
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: For each remaining savings + card pair, compute net yearly return: deposit × (base or tier APY for that balance + that card's APY bonus for that account + linked-checking boost if the pair is listed) − 12 × monthly maintenance fee if the balance is below the minimum − 12 × paper statement fee if paper is needed − the card's annual fee
steps.quote: Only the highest applicable credit card APY bonus is applied to the customer's savings account.

steps.do: Extend compute: also loop over each checking class from filter_checking. Add that class's linked boost for the savings class only when the pair is in the qualifying list (e.g. Green Account (checking) + Gold +0.75%, Blue + Platinum +0.8%, Blue + Silver Plus +0.35%, Evergreen + Green (savings) +0.55%, Purple + Gold +0.1%), keeping only the highest boost if the customer holds several checking accounts. Use only savings accounts left by filter_min_balance and cards left by filter_card_features. Rank by the savings APY and net yearly return; do not subtract the checking account's waivable maintenance fee, but note it for recommend_combo.
steps.if: the customer wants or accepts a new checking account
steps.quote: The boost is additive to your savings account's base APY and any credit card APY bonuses you may already have.

steps.do: Recommend the ONE pair with the highest net return, explain briefly why, and confirm the customer agrees
steps.quote: Confirm account selection with customer

steps.do: Add to the recommendation in recommend: the ONE checking class from compute_with_new_checking, giving the total APY with each part (base, checking boost, card bonus). Confirm it meets every stated requirement (e.g. early direct deposit days, the card's travel insurance) and state the checking account's maintenance fee and waiver (Green Account (checking): $22.50 a month unless the daily balance stays at $1,350). Give one answer even if the customer asks for options.
steps.if: the customer wants or accepts a new checking account
steps.quote: To avoid the monthly maintenance fee, maintain a minimum daily balance of $1,350 each statement cycle

steps.do: Explain the order before opening anything: open the savings account first, because it needs an active checking account already held at least 14 days and a newly opened checking account does not qualify; then open the new checking account and have the customer apply for the card; close the old checking account last. If the customer pushes back, give this reason again; do not just insist.
steps.if: the customer wants to open savings and also open or close a checking account
steps.quote: Must have held their checking account for at least 14 days

steps.do: Tell the customer the agent cannot submit a credit card application for them. They submit it with their own apply_for_credit_card tool, giving card_type = the exact recommended card name (e.g. 'Silver Rewards Card'), customer_name = their full name, annual_income = their income, rho_bank_subscription = true or false. Say the application involves a credit check and approval is not guaranteed. Ask for annual income and subscription status if not yet given.
steps.if: the customer accepts the recommendation and wants the card
steps.quote: Consent to a credit check and submit any requested documentation

steps.do: The customer applies for the recommended card themselves
steps.if: the customer accepts the recommendation
steps.quote: Complete the online application with your personal information and income details

steps.do: Acknowledge the submitted application. Explain the card's savings APY bonus applies automatically once the card and the savings account are both held. If the customer reports an error or decline, explain what they saw and do not promise approval or apply for a different card unless they ask.
steps.if: the customer ran apply_for_credit_card
steps.quote: Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides bonus APY on your Gold Account balance.

steps.do: Read the customer's credit cards to see whether the new card now appears on the profile, and tell the customer.
steps.if: the customer reports they applied
steps.quote: The system identifies all active Rho-Bank credit cards linked to the customer's profile.

steps.do: If the customer asks you to open the recommended savings account, continue with the job opening_personal_savings_accounts using the recommended full official account_class (e.g. 'Gold Account'). Do not verify again, and do not open a checking account unless the customer asked for one (then see handoff_open_checking).
steps.if: the customer accepts the recommendation and asks for the savings account to be opened
steps.quote: Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account

steps.do: After the savings account is opened, continue with opening_personal_checking_accounts using the recommended checking class's full official name (e.g. 'Green Account (checking)'). Do not verify again.
steps.if: the customer accepted a recommended new checking account and asks for it to be opened
steps.quote: Confirm the customer's desired account_class selection.

steps.do: After the new accounts are open, continue with closing_personal_checking_accounts for the old checking account the customer wants closed.
steps.if: the customer also asked to close an old checking account
steps.quote: Must have held their checking account for at least 14 days

Green Account (savings) is out (paperless) and EcoCard is out. Gold Account + Silver Rewards Card = deposit × 5.7% − $120 in maintenance fees. It beats Gold + Bronze Rewards (5.65% − $120), Silver Plus + Silver or Bronze Rewards (3.15%), Silver + Crypto-Cash Back (3.0% − $75), Silver + Silver Rewards (2.6%) and Bronze + any card (minus $24 for paper). From $10,000 up the Gold fee falls away. Always recompute with the actual deposit.

done_when: The customer is verified and logged. All needed facts are collected. One savings account + credit card pair (plus one new checking account when the customer wants one) with the highest return under the customer's constraints has been recommended with its APY breakdown, and the customer has agreed to it (or has been told no pair fits and why). The order of openings and closures has been explained when relevant. If the customer wanted the card, they have applied with apply_for_credit_card or declined. If they asked for accounts to be opened or closed, the work continues in opening_personal_savings_accounts, then opening_personal_checking_accounts, then closing_personal_checking_accounts.
